reason: The first counted collab is free, so I'd just try that and see if the café owner even bothers asking people for my coupon. I'm not paying ₹499 for Auto-DM and unlimited posts when the cafés I work with still pay me in food.
objection: Local cafés pay in food, not money. A counter record only helps if the next owner actually cares about numbers, and most of them in South Bengaluru just want a free reel.
would_change_my_mind: If my free collab showed a real count, like 20+ customers, and a café then paid me cash because of it, I'd buy the pass.
